business_problem: combine subscriber and transactional data fast enough to support journalism, understand reader preferences, and reduce the cost of a fragmented data estate.
solution_summary: Neue Zürcher Zeitung uses Snowflake on Snowflake to combine subscriber and transactional data fast enough to support journalism, understand reader preferences, and reduce the cost of a fragmented data estate. Transactional and user-behavior data are consolidated in Snowflake so the publisher can analyze readership trends and subscriber preferences from one place. The platform replaced slower and more fragmented processing paths, letting NZZ refresh and analyze large datasets much faster while keeping storage and compute costs under control. Editorial, analytics, and subscription teams use the unified data to understand readers better, improve decision-making, and support high-quality journalism with fresher insight. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across teams and applications.
